changes: weekday normalized to 'Monday (roja 2)' instead of the bare 'roja 2'
notes expanded: the century and era of '64 sāla' cannot be recovered; the closing verses are stock scribal formulae

notes: The colophon gives the year only as '64 sāla', with no century and no era. Writing the date with 'sāla' and 'roja' points to the late Śāha period, so VS [19]64 (c. 1907/08 CE) is one possibility, but nothing in the colophon decides the era or the century, so ce_approx is left empty. 'roja 2' means Monday. The verses 'bhagnapṛṣṭikaṭigrīvā…' and 'yādṛśaṃ pustakaṃ dṛṣṭvā…' are stock scribal formulae. The colophon names no one who commissioned or owned the copy.
